bounds: Eight scenarios: no stored zone or a valid stored zone (Europe/Berlin), then one owner statement: an IANA zone, the same zone ending the sentence with a period, an alias ending the sentence, or text that names no zone. The implementation check sends each generated scenario through the real owner.profile_extraction evaluator (runResponseHandlerEvaluators) on a fresh PGlite runtime with the production plugin, then reads the stored owner zone and the shared calendar zone. Model-extracted timezone facts (core-fact-memory-bridge.ts), other fact keys, the full alias table and concurrent owner messages remain outside this model. Safety is unconditional.
